faq.title: About
faq.lead: Short answers on professional role, training and responsible AI use.
faq.q1: Who is Ulises Antonio Ponce Pretelin?
faq.a1: A physical therapist and clinical AI engineer in Xalapa, Veracruz. He combines clinical care and inclusion work (Mexico and the U.S.) with clinical systems design and applied AI.
faq.a2: Ongoing Anthropic training (Claude, API, MCP, Claude Code, skills and agents), plus the mouredev × BIG school AI Development with Agents program (2026).
faq.q3: How does he combine clinical care and AI?
faq.a3: He starts from clinical reasoning and EBP to design tools; AI supports documentation, safety and workflows — it does not diagnose or replace the professional.
faq.a4: Selected work: a clinical manager with referenced evidence and optional AI for physical therapy. It has its own demo; this portfolio is about Ulises, not a product catalog.
